column1: # test/registry.tsv -- declarative inventory of the test/ suite.
# Extracts the previously implicit "which test is executed by what" contract
# out of .github/workflows/*.yml, where it existed only as ~97 hand-written
#   ci       runner = comma-separated .github/workflows/ files that must each
#            still reference this test. Dropping the last reference fails the
#            guard instead of silently going dark.
#   nested   runner = the test/ script that executes this one. Only used where
#            an actual invocation was confirmed, never a prose mention.
#   helper   harness/launcher, not an assertion runner; nothing executes it
#   unwired  KNOWN GAP: reachable from no workflow. This is dark coverage
#            tracked by frostyard/snosi#851 -- NOT an approved manual-only
#            class. Moving an entry out of `unwired` requires wiring it up.
# The guard intentionally does NOT require that every file under test/ appear
# here, so that in-flight branches adding tests do not break on merge.
